decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Within three months of the date of this approval, the consent holder shall submit to and have approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a plan showing details of hard and soft landscaping to be provided at the front of the site (including the retention of the existing tree located within the front garden). The landscaping shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Retention of conversion of garage to habitable room, two-storey side extension and single-storey rear extension to existing house.
